<BODY bgcolor="#ffffff">
<P align="right"><strong><font size="2" face="Times New Roman, Times, serif">Exhibit 4.3</font> </strong></P>
<P align="center"><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO RIGHTS AGREEMENT</FONT></B></P>
<P align="left">
  <font size="2">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT face="serif">Amendment No.
  2 dated as of October 19, 2006 (&#147;<B>Amendment No. 2</B>&#148;) to the
  Rights Agreement dated as of December 11, 1996 (the &#147;<B>Original Rights Agreement</B>&#148;),
  as amended by Amendment No. 1 dated as of October 15, 1998 (&#147;<B>Amendment No. 1</B>&#148;;
  the Original Rights Agreement as amended by Amendment No. 1, the &#147;<B>Rights Agreement</B>&#148;)
  between Deltic Timber Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the &#147;<B>Company</B>&#148;), and Harris N.A. (formerly known as, Harris Trust and Sa&#118;ings
Bank), as Rights Agent (the &#147;<B>Rights Agent</B>&#148;). </FONT></font></P>
<P align="center">
<B><FONT size=2 face="serif">W I T N E S S E T H</FONT></B></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">WHEREAS, on December 11, 1996 the Company entered into the Original Rights Agreement with the Rights Agent and the Board of Directors of the Company authorized and declared a di&#118;idend of one
preferred stock purchase right (a &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Right</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148;) for each share of common stock of the Company par &#118;alue &#36;0.01 each (the &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Common
Stock</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148;) outstanding at the close of business on December 18, 1996 (the &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Record Date</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148;) and authorized the issuance, upon the terms and subject to
the conditions set forth in the Original Rights Agreement, of one Right in respect of each share of Common Stock of the Company issued after the Record Date, each Right representing the right to purchase from the Company, upon the terms and subject
to the conditions set forth in the Original Rights Agreement, one one-hundredth of a share of Series A Participating Cumulati&#118;e Preferred Stock of the Company par &#118;alue &#36;0.01 each; and</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">WHEREAS, the Original Rights Agreement was amended by Amendment No. 1 thereto; and</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire to make an additional amendment to the Rights Agreement to extend its term and to make certain other changes;</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto agree as follows:</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 1</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Definitions. </FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">Each of the following definitions in Section 1 of the Rights Agreement is hereby amended in its entirety to read as
follows:</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">&#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Final Expiration Date</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148; means the close of business on December 31, 2016.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">&#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Purchase Price</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148; means the price (subject to adjustment as pro&#118;ided herein) at which a holder of a Right may purchase one
one-hundredth of a share of Preferred Stock (subject to adjustment as pro&#118;ided herein) upon exercise of a Right, which price shall initially be &#36;200.00.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 2</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Exemptions.</FONT></I></P>

<br>
<br>
<hr size=3 color=GRAY noshade>
<p style="page-break-before:always"></p>
<PAGE>
<br>
<br>


<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(a) Section 1 of the Rights Agreement is hereby amended by deleting the definition of &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Exempt Holder</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(b) The definition of the term &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Acquiring Person</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148; in Section 1 of the Rights Agreement is hereby amended by: (i) deleting the
parenthetical &#147;(other than an Exempt Holder)&#148;; and (ii) deleting the words &#147;or an Exempt Holder&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(c) The definition of the term &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Associate</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148; in Section 1 of the Rights Agreement is hereby amended by adding the phrase &#147;,
except that the phrase &#147;or who is a director or officer of the registrant or any of its parents or subsidiaries&#148; shall be deemed deleted from the definition of the term &#147;Associate&#148; in Rule 12b-2 for purposes of this
Agreement&#148; after the word &#147;hereof&#148; at the end of the paragraph.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(d) The definition of the terms &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Beneficial Owner</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148;, &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Beneficial Ownership</FONT></B><FONT
face="serif">&#148; and &#147;</FONT><B><FONT size=2 face="serif">beneficially own</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="serif">&#148; in Section 1 of the Rights Agreement is hereby amended by: (i) deleting the parenthetical &#147;(other than an Exempt Holder)&#148; in
subsection (a) and subsection (b); (ii) deleting the parenthetical &#147;(other than an Exempt Holder)&#148; each place it appears in subsection (c); and (iii) deleting the words &#147;or an Exempt Holder&#148; each place they appear in the
pro&#118;iso to subsection (c) .</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(e) Section 13(a)(i) of the Rights Agreement is hereby amended by adding the phrase &#147;on or after the Distribution Date,&#148; after the phrase &#147;upon exercise thereof&#148; and prior to the
phrase &#147;at the Purchase Price&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 3</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Form of Right Certificate</FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(a) Section 3(d) of the
Rights Agreement is hereby amended by: (i) adding the phrase &#147;, as amended
by Amendment No. 1 dated as of October 15, 1998 and Amendment No. 2 dated as
of October 19, 2006&#148; after the number &#147;1996&#148; and prior to the
parenthetical &#147;(the &#147;Rights
Agreement&#148;)&#148;; and (ii) replacing the phrase &#147;Harris Trust and
Sa&#118;ings Bank&#148; after the phrase &#147;Deltic Timber Corporation
and&#148; and prior to the phrase &#147;, dated as of December 11, 1996&#148; with
the phrase &#147;Harris N.A. (formerly known as Harris Trust and Sa&#118;ings
Bank)&#148;</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(b) Exhibit B to the
Rights Agreement is hereby amended by: (i) replacing the date &#147;December
31, 2006&#148; in the legend, with the date &#147;December 31, 2016&#148;; (ii)
adding the phrase
&#147;, as amended by Amendment No. 1 dated as of October 15, 1998 and Amendment
No. 2 dated as of October 19, 2006&#148; after the number &#147;1996&#148; and
prior to the parenthetical &#147;(the &#147;Rights Agreement&#148;)&#148; in
the first  paragraph; (iii) replacing the amount of &#147;&#36;75.00&#148; in
the first paragraph with the amount of &#147;&#36;200.00&#148;; (i&#118;) replacing
the date &#147;December 18, 1996&#148; in the third paragraph, with the date &#147;October
19,  2006&#148;; and (&#118;) replacing the phrase &#147;, and </FONT></P>
<P align="center">
<FONT size=2 face="serif">2</FONT></P>

<br>
<br>
<hr size=3 color=GRAY noshade>
<p style="page-break-before:always"></p>
<PAGE>
<br>
<br>


<P align="left">
<FONT size=2 face="serif">Harris Trust and Sa&#118;ings Bank&#148; after the parenthetical &#147;(the &#147;Company&#148;)&#148; and prior to the phrase &#147;, as Rights Agent&#148; with the phrase &#147;, and Harris N.A. (formerly known as Harris Trust
and Sa&#118;ings Bank)&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(c) Each reference in Exhibit B to &#147;19__&#148; is hereby replaced with a reference to &#147;20__&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">(d) The phrase &#147;Harris Trust and Sa&#118;ings Bank&#148; set forth on the signature page of Exhibit B is hereby replaced with the phrase &#147;Harris N.A.&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 4</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Defined Terms; References</FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Unless otherwise specifically defined herein, each term used herein which is defined in the Rights
Agreement has the meaning assigned to such term in the Rights Agreement. Each reference to &#147;hereof&#148;, &#147;hereunder&#148;, &#147;herein&#148; and &#147;hereby&#148; and each other similar reference and each reference to &#147;this
Agreement&#148; and each other similar reference shall, after this Amendment No. 2 becomes effecti&#118;e, refer to the Rights Agreement as amended hereby.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 5</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Inconsistency. </FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">Except as amended hereby, all of the terms of the Rights Agreement shall remain and continue in full force and
effect and are hereby confirmed in all respects. In the e&#118;ent of any inconsistency between the pro&#118;isions of this Amendment No. 2 and the Rights Agreement, the pro&#118;isions of this Amendment No. 2 shall pre&#118;ail.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 6</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Go&#118;erning Law. </FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">This Amendment No. 2 shall be go&#118;erned by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of
Delaware without regard to any applicable conflicts of law rules, except that the rights and obligations of the Rights Agent shall be go&#118;erned by the laws of the State of New York.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 7</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Se&#118;erability. </FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">If any term, pro&#118;ision, co&#118;enant or restriction of this Amendment No. 2 is held by a court of
competent jurisdiction or other authority to be in&#118;alid, &#118;oid or unenforceable, the remainder of the terms, pro&#118;isions, co&#118;enants and restrictions of this Amendment No. 2 shall remain in full force and effect and shall in no way
be affected, impaired or in&#118;alidated.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 8</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Counterparts. </FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">This Amendment No. 2 may be signed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be an original, with the same
effect as if the signatures thereto and hereto were upon the same instrument.</FONT></P>
<P align="left">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Section 9</FONT><I><FONT size=2 face="serif">. Effecti&#118;eness. </FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif">This Amendment No. 2 shall become effecti&#118;e upon execution by each of the parties hereto of a counterpart
hereof.</FONT></P>
